issues.summary: Book the piano tuner before the recital
issues.description:
The recital is on **Saturday 3 October**, so the tuning has to be done by the week before.

Last time we used [Harbour Piano Services](https://harbourpiano.example/booking). Their number is on the fridge.

Ask whether they can also look at the sticking middle C.

issues.summary: Compare quotes for the new boiler
issues.description:
Three quotes so far:

| Company | Price | Warranty |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northside Heating | 2,450 pounds | 7 years |
| Brightwarm | 2,890 pounds | 10 years |
| A. Patel and Sons | 2,300 pounds | 5 years |

The survey from Brightwarm says the flue needs moving, which the others did not mention.

Decide by the end of the month so the fitting happens before it gets cold.

comments.author: Sam
comments.text: Brightwarm's longer warranty might be worth the extra. See HOME-4 for what went wrong last time.

issues.summary: Set up the talking kitchen scales
issues.description:
The scales arrived. The quick start guide is print only.

The manufacturer has an audio guide at https://scales.example.com/audio-guide.mp3 which should cover pairing.

To reset them, hold the `UNIT` and `TARE` buttons together for five seconds.

issues.summary: Choose plants for the raised bed
issues.description:
Ideas so far:

- Rosemary and thyme along the edge, for scent
- Lamb's ear, for texture
- Sweet peas up the trellis

The bed gets sun in the afternoon only.
Two players are due back on the 19th. The library is open until 1 pm on Saturdays.
Saturday 26 September, 10 until 2. Robin is on the plant stall from 11.
